options.value: A = False, B = False, C = True
A = True, B = False, C = False
A = True, B = True, C = True
A = False, B = False, C = False

explanation.value: A=F,B=F,C=T: elif (B or (A and C)) is True -> print(B and not A)=False. A=T,B=T,C=T: first if false, elif True -> print(B and not A)=print(True and not True)=False. The other two output True.
